title: Anuvani-Diarization: Zero Shot Speaker Diarization and Annotation Conventions Across 22 Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.20327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: India's 22 scheduled languages are spoken by over a billion people in conversations that mix languages, often within one turn, overlap freely, and take place over telephones, in meetings, and in media. Knowing who spoke when, the task of speaker diarization, is essential to speech applications for such conversation: voice agents conversing with several people at once, speaker attributed transcription of meetings and calls, contact center analytics, and media monitoring. We present a systematic study of speaker diarization across all 22 languages on IndicDiarBench and introduce Anuvani-Diarization, which adapts a self-supervised end-to-end segmentation model to Indian conversation with uncertainty aware silver supervision. Evaluated zero shot alongside nine recent diarization systems, it reaches a duration weighted diarization error rate (DER) of 16.78% on all 1,164 recordings, the lowest of all systems we ran and second only to the best

translated_title: Anuvani-Diarization：面向22种语言的零样本说话人日志与标注规范
translated_abstract: 印度的22种表列语言由超过十亿人使用，他们的对话常常混杂多种语言（甚至在同一话轮内），语音重叠频繁，并发生在电话、会议和媒体等多种场景中。明确“谁在何时说话”，即说话人日志任务，对此类对话的语音应用至关重要：例如与多人同时交流的语音代理、会议和通话的说话人归属转录、呼叫中心分析以及媒体监控。我们在IndicDiarBench上对全部22种语言的说话人日志进行了系统研究，并提出Anuvani-Diarization，该方法通过不确定性感知的银标准监督，将自监督端到端分割模型适配到印度语对话场景。在零样本设置下与九个近期日志系统一同评估，该方法在全部1,164条录音上取得了16.78%的时长加权说话人日志错误率（DER），是我们所运行的所有系统中最低的，仅次于最佳系统（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出Anuvani-Diarization，通过不确定性感知的银标准监督将自监督端到端分割模型适配到印度22种表列语言的多语言对话场景，实现零样本说话人日志，在IndicDiarBench上取得16.78%的最低时长加权错误率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Anuvani-Diarization, a zero-shot speaker diarization system that adapts a self-supervised end-to-end segmentation model to Indian multilingual conversations using uncertainty-aware silver supervision, achieving the lowest duration-weighted DER of 16.78% across all 22 scheduled Indian languages on IndicDiarBench.
